name: Peach Crêpe Cake

cookwares.name: stand mixer fitted with whisk attachment or electric handheld mixer

ingredients.name: fresh firm-ripe peaches, peeled and chopped

instructions.primary_message: For the Peach Filling: Adjust oven rack to lowest position and preheat oven to 400°F. In an 8-by-8-inch baking dish, stir together peaches, lemon juice, and 3 tablespoons granulated sugar. Bake until peaches are very soft and syrup has slightly thickened, about 30 minutes. Remove from oven, and increase oven temperature to 450°F.

Carefully pour peach mixture into a blender jar. Secure lid on blender, and remove center piece to allow steam to escape. Place a clean towel over opening. Blend, starting on low speed and increasing speed gradually to high, until peach mixture is very smooth, stopping to scrape down sides of bowl as needed, about 1 minute. (Use caution when puréeing hot ingredients and do not overfill the blender.) Transfer to a heat-proof bowl, and refrigerate, uncovered, until chilled, about 2 hours.

For the Crêpe: Meanwhile, in a large bowl, whisk together flour, salt, and 1 tablespoon granulated sugar. In a separate medium bowl, whisk together milk and eggs. Whisk about half of milk mixture into flour mixture until smooth. In a microwave-safe bowl, heat 2 tablespoons butter on 50% power until melted, about 30 seconds.
Whisk melted butter into flour mixture. Whisk remaining milk mixture into flour mixture until smooth; set batter aside.

Evenly grease a large rimmed (12-by-17-inch) nonstick baking sheet with remaining 2 tablespoons butter. Pour batter into center of prepared sheet; tilt sheet to distribute batter evenly, using a small offset spatula to help, if needed. Bake until crêpe is set and edges are browned and pull away from sides of sheet, 6 to 7 minutes. Let cool to room temperature on sheet, about 15 minutes.

For the Cream Filling: Meanwhile, in a stand mixer fitted with whisk attachment or in a bowl with a handheld electric mixer, beat cream cheese and remaining 3 tablespoons sugar on medium speed until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes. With mixer on medium speed, gradually add cream and beat until just starting to thicken, 3 to 4 minutes. Increase speed to medium-high and beat until stiff peaks form, 1 to 2 minutes.

To Assemble Crêpe Cake: Once crêpe has cooled, use 2 spatulas to carefully transfer it to a work surface. Using an offset spatula or back of a large spoon, spread cream cheese mixture evenly over crêpe. Next, spread chilled peach mixture evenly over cream cheese mixture.
Starting at a shorter end, roll crêpe tightly into a log. Transfer crêpe to a platter. Chill crêpe roll until filling is set, at least 2 hours and preferably 8 to 12 hours.
Just before serving, garnish with whipped cream, powdered sugar, and sliced peaches. Slice and serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: crepe roll cake, crepe cake recipe, peach crepe cake recipe

description: This easy sheet-pan crêpe roll delivers the layered elegance of a crêpe cake without the fuss. Rolled with roasted peach purée and whipped cream cheese, it's the ultimate make-ahead summer dessert: light, refreshing, and perfect for slicing.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 5 hr 5 min.

Optional or for serving: 1 peach thinly sliced for garnish; Powdered sugar for serving; Homemade or store-bought whipped cream for serving

Make-ahead and storage: The peach filling can be made up to 3 days ahead and refrigerated in an airtight container.
The cream cheese filling can be made up to 3 days ahead and refrigerated in an airtight container.
The filled crêpe roll can be refrigerated, covered, for up to 3 days.
author: Leah Colins
